response: Yes, emergency double-balloon enteroscopy combined with real-time viewing of capsule endoscopy is a feasible combined approach in acute overt-obscure gastrointestinal bleeding. This approach allows for rapid and accurate diagnosis and treatment of bleeding lesions in the small intestine, which can be difficult to detect and access using traditional endoscopy methods. The combination of double-balloon enteroscopy and capsule endoscopy provides a comprehensive evaluation of the small bowel, increasing the likelihood of identifying the source of bleeding and enabling timely intervention.
